# Step 2.225: no person's id in any public answer

## Where a person's or roster place's id was public (before this step)

- `GET /api/v1/leagues/{id}/games/{game}/snapshot` (contract `GameSnapshot`,
  `packages/contracts/src/tracker-protocol.ts`): `players[].playerId` was the person's id
  (`read-game-snapshot.ts`, the engine keys a game's players by person id).
- The public game page `/{league}/games/{game}`: the same snapshot is the `initial` prop of the
  client `LiveGameView` (so in the page's flight data), and the box score rows took
  `id: p.personId` (`build-game.ts` `buildBoxScores`, drawn by `packages/ui` `BoxScoreTable`).
- The live message (`LiveMessage`, `LatestPlay`) carries the game's id only, no person's.
- Stats pages: record 070 took the id off already. Schedule, standings, teams, home: no
  person id in their answers by the contracts; layer 2's scan proves it as served.

## Scorer-only answers (staff; not changed by this step)

`/games/{game}/rosters`, `/state`, `/commands`, `/session`, `/copy`, `/format`, `/reopen`,
`/not-started`, `/scoring`, `/staff-numbers`, `/my-team`, the score pages `/{league}/score/...`
and every admin page: they carry person ids (the tracker protocol, `live-stats.ts`,
`varsity.ts`) and keep them.
